## R Visualization Using ggplot2

```{r}
data <- read.csv("penglings.csv")
```

Call the ggplot2 library (I already have it installed on my system)
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

### Create the visualization

```{r}
ggplot(data, 
       aes(x = flipper_length_mm, 
           y = body_mass_g,
           size = bill_length_mm,
           color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
       y = "Body Mass (g)",
       title = "Body Mass by Flipper Length - Jake Dorick") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Adelie" = "slateblue", "Chinstrap" = "darkgreen", "Gentoo" = "pink1"))
```
